newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$900 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$900 mln of notes.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will offer a total of A$900 million of Treasury notes for tender on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
The tender comprises A$200 million of five-week notes, A$200 million of 13-week notes and A$500 million of 26-week notes.
The RBA said it would take up an additional A$100 million of five-week notes, A$200 million the 13-week notes and A$300 million of 26-week notes for its own portfolio.
The Treasury last week offered a total of A$1.3 billion of notes, comprising A$200 million of five-week notes, A$400 million of 13-week notes and A$700 million of 26-week notes.
There are A$160 million of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending September 25.
